text:
Anna W: Heads-up — CI Snyk scan flaky on main. 'snyk-scan' job times out ~20-30m for big monorepo. Anyone seen this?

DevSec Bot: workflow run failed: runner did not respond, container exit 137 (OOM). logs:
```
Error: runner timeout after 30m
Container killed with exit code 137
Trace: oom_killer triggered while scanning large node_modules tree
```

Mike K: I hit this too. Suggest splitting package-level scans, or increase timeout + use matrix job. Example snippet:
```
jobs:
  snyk:
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      matrix:
        path: ["web", "api", "infra"]
```

Sara L: Splitting is good. Also we should avoid ignoring entire vuln IDs in Snyk unless security signs off. Use project-level .snyk policy for devDeps only.

Luis P: We have recurring false positives from devDependencies in infra/. Can we add a suppression rule? Who's allowed to add? CC @Anna W @Jen T

Anna W: Only the 'security-team' group in GHAS should be able to add suppressions. We need audit log entries for any suppression changes. Also Ops: can we store the .snyk token in a KMS-backed secret and rotate it regularly?

Jen T: Yes — store tokens in our secrets manager (KMS) and use short-lived creds. Also we'll add CODEOWNERS + RBAC for 'security-triage' role. I'll open a PR to lock suppression modifies.

Mike K: For immediate fix, increase job timeout to 45m and run nightly full scan (non blocking). CI should only fail on new high/critical vulns.

DevSec Bot: scheduled nightly-scan created (cron: '0 2 * * *').

Sara L: On aligning scanners: Trivy handles container images, Snyk/Dependabot for deps, GHAS for code-level. We should standardize severity mapping and which scanner's findings are authoritative for blocking.

Luis P: Can we add a suppression policy for 'devDependency' scope? Snyk supports `--dev=false` but not ideal for our monorepo. Alternatively filter in our triage pipeline: drop findings where pkgPath matches /node_modules/ and scope=='dev'.

Anna W: Good plan. Can someone add a lightweight triage job that enriches findings and posts to #security with labels? Low effort, big win.

Jen T: I'll draft the workflow today. Also request: audit log must include user and KMS key id when suppression changed.

Mike K: FYI I pushed patch to GH Actions: increased timeout and split matrix for web/api. Run seemed stable on fork.

Sara L: thanks — let's monitor for 48h and open follow-up if we still see OOMs. :thumbsup:
